faqs.q: Sec. 74-62. - Membership; appointment of members; term of office.
faqs.a:
The city planning commission shall consist of seven members who shall be appointed
               by the city council. All members shall be selected from among the duly qualified electors
               of the city and reside in the city, and if any member ceases to reside in the city,
               his or her membership on the commission shall automatically terminate. After the existing
               members' terms expire, all subsequent appointments shall be for four year terms, provided
               that any appointments to fill unexpired terms shall be for the balance of the term
               of the member being replaced and in the same manner prescribed in this section. The
               term of each appointed member shall be four years, or until a successor takes office,
               except that the terms of the existing members shall remain in effect until said member's
               term expires. Members may serve up to three consecutive four-year terms.
(Code 1960, § 2-21; Code 1981, § 25-32; Ord. No. 3434, § 1, 1-5-1998; Ord. No.
4796
, § 1, 4-18-2022)
State Law reference—
Similar provisions, C.R.S. § 31-23-203.
